newsitem.title: TURKEY: Cukurova Elektrik sells cement stakes.
newsitem.headline: Cukurova Elektrik sells cement stakes.

text.p: Turkish utility Cukurova Elektrik A.S. said it sold part of its equity stakes in five cement firms for a total of 4.13 trillion lira.

The company said in a statement sent to the Istanbul stock exchange that 680,000 shares in Trabzon Cimento were sold for 799.3 billion lira, 215,530 shares in Bartin Cimento for 492.6 billion lira, 196,068 shares in Gaziantep Cimento for 1,144.9 billion, 650,000 shares in Sanliurfa Cimento for 648.2 billion and 1,670,000 shares in Ladik Cimento for 1,042.4 billion lira.
The company did not disclose to whom the sale was made, but said a 2,253.35 billion lira profit was obtained from the sale.
The profit was recorded under "re-evaluation of funds" item listed under company equity.
